$comment: Claim register. Every checkable claim published on the site that depends on an external source, a statistic, or a statement about Clinovian's own experience. Review interval is SHORT for fees, deadlines and rule implementation dates, and EVENT for claims that should be rechecked when a named source changes, whether or not the scheduled date has arrived. Do not publish a fresh review date on a page unless a substantive review actually occurred.

claims.claim: Medicare Advantage enrollee reconsideration window is 65 calendar days from the notice date
claims.source: CMS Medicare Managed Care Manual ch.13
claims.population: MA enrollee reconsideration only; not provider disputes, contractual procedures or external review

claims.claim: OIG: 12% of SNF admission requests denied; 18% of denials appealed; 95% of appealed denials overturned
claims.source: HHS OIG review of MA prior authorisation for SNF admissions
claims.population: Defined sample of MA organisations over a defined period. 95% applies to appealed denials only and is self-selected.

claims.claim: OIG: 36% overturn for appealed LTCH denials, 43% for appealed IRF denials
claims.population: Appealed denials in those settings only. Not interchangeable with the SNF figure.

claims.claim: CMS-0057-F: 72-hour expedited and 7-calendar-day standard decision timeframes
claims.population: Impacted payers only. QHP issuers on the Federally-facilitated Exchanges are expressly excluded from the decision-timeframe provision. Non-API provisions generally 2026; API provisions generally 2027.

claims.claim: Federal IDR 2026 implementation dates: $15 fee 11 June; general effectiveness 3 August; batching for open negotiations from 1 November
claims.population: Each provision has its own date. Portal-dependent provisions separately announced.

claims.claim: N17.9 is a CC and N17.0 an MCC on the FY2026 MS-DRG v43 list
claims.source: CMS FY2026 MS-DRG Definitions Manual v43, Appendix C
claims.population: FY2026 v43 only; subject to CC/MCC exclusion logic. Recheck every fiscal year.

claims.claim: Skilled coverage does not turn on potential for improvement (Jimmo)
MA organisations are required to apply Medicare inpatient admission criteria; the FFS medical review presumption does not transfer
claims.population: Medicare FFS and MA. Not commercial or self-funded plans.
Founder experience across prior payer-side roles. NOT Clinovian outcomes and not successful appeals. Supporting records maintained by the reviewer.

claims.claim: Behavioural health denial and appeal rate ranking
claims.population: Ranking REMOVED 13 Sep 2026. Do not reinstate without a defined comparative dataset.

claims.claim: Comparative evaluation of AI appeal tools
claims.population: Comparative claim REMOVED 13 Sep 2026. Examples are hypothetical. Do not reinstate without publishing methodology, sample and scoring criteria.

claims.claim: Federal IDR volume, win-rate and offer statistics
claims.source: CMS IDR public use files — denominators NOT independently verified
claims.population: Figures REMOVED 13 Sep 2026. Any figure added later must cite the specific report and table and reproduce its denominator.
